verdict.rationale: Spline documents generative AI features: an AI Agent that builds and edits scenes, AI textures, AI 3D generation, and an OpenAI API integration for scene interactivity. None of these is documented as analyzing the user's own data or files to surface insights or suggestions inside the product. These features are adjacent generation tools or developer building blocks, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
